title: Context Lens & Packs | ContextMint Docs
description: Context Lens gate 1 preview, relevance scores, context packs, @pack activation, scan and learn, and stale pack handling.
lead: Context Lens is gate 1: preview retrieved evidence before the model runs. Context packs are curated markdown knowledge you activate per repo or session.

workflow.title: Context Lens workflow
items: Type a question and send (or enable pre-send preview in settings).
Context Lens shows retrieved chunks, scores, routing choice, and governance notes.
Approve or adjust — exclude chunks you do not want in the prompt.
Answer streams after approval (or immediately if preview is off).

regions.title: Lens UI regions
items: Summary strip — chunk count, model route, vision route when images attached, lane label when applicable
Evidence drawer — per-file chunks with relevance scores; image thumbnail strip when screenshots attached
Governance drawer — quality-map findings (inform-only or gated per policy)
Actions — Send (chat) and Run visual audit (ARGUS) when image evidence is present

scores.title: Scores and filtering
scores.text: Scores reflect hybrid retrieval (vector + BM25 + boosts for recent/attached files). Low scores do not always mean “wrong” — structural skeleton fallback may apply when line-level query filters miss.

packs.title: Context packs
packs.text: Packs live under .contextmint/packs/ in your repo (or session packs for Work lane). Each pack has a manifest.yaml and markdown sources.

activate.title: Activate a pack in chat
activate.text: Type @pack:pack-name in the compose bar or select from the packs panel.

scanLearn.title: Scan & learn
scanLearn.text: After indexing completes, use Scan & learn in the packs panel to build or refresh packs from repo conventions. Auto-sync can debounce on file changes (configurable).

stale.title: Stale packs banner
stale.text: When source files change, you may see a stale-pack prompt — rebuild to keep pack content aligned with the codebase.

workLane.title: Work lane and packs
workLane.text: Work context lane relies heavily on session packs and attachments instead of vector search. Build session notes into packs for recurring planning workflows.
